title: Build the sentiment-meter CLI
description:
Build scripts/sentiment-meter.ts (ts-node pattern matching existing scripts) wired as pnpm run sentiment:meter. Flags: --window (today, yesterday, last-24h, Nh, Nd, all; default today), --since/--until (absolute ISO-8601 bounds), --day-start HH:MM (default local midnight), --timezone (IANA; invalid names fail fast), --sources (subset), --json, --cache-dir, --doctor (validate roots and report format drift, no counting). Text output shows counts, a gauge bar, band, and the resolved window; --json emits the machine-readable report. Output never contains message text.

Done when: the CLI renders correct output for every window kind over fixtures; flags parse and override config; doctor works.
